definitions.explanation: The mental faculty by which one decides on actions. Determination to do something.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{意志|いし}を{持|も}っている。
{本人|ほんにん}の{意志|いし}を{尊重|そんちょう}する。

notes:
{意志|いし} refers to one's will or determination.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意志|いし}が{強|つよ}い/{弱|よわ}い (strong/weak will)
- {意志|いし}を{持|も}つ (have a will)
- {自分|じぶん}の{意志|いし}で (of one's own will)
- {意志|いし}を{尊重|そんちょう}する (respect one's will)

KANJI NOTE:
- {意志|いし}: will, volition (determination)
- {意思|いし}: intention, mind (what one thinks)
- Both read いし but have subtle differences
